outcomes.reason: Public perspective and orthographic camera builders forward tile controls; scene cameras crop the full-image frustum and retain its aspect through renderer viewport resize. Source cases cover adjoining tiles, physical lens shift, orthographic resize modes and renderer entry points. Tests and browser/device acceptance were not run in this audit.

outcomes.description: line segments
outcomes.reason: The public API exposes independent line-segment pairs and the live line compiler turns them into geometry.

outcomes.description: sorted fallback
outcomes.reason: The weighted-transparency helper accepts opaque depth, owns per-view resources and invokes a supplied sorted fallback. The regular renderer does not reference the helper for weighted-mode selection, leaving an integrated weighted path and its fallback incomplete.

outcomes.description: Test every supported state, variant key, integer/normalized layout, separate instance stream and invalid combination.
outcomes.reason: The source tests cover many states, cache keys, separate streams, scalar and selected vector formats and invalid combinations. They do not explicitly exercise every supported integer/normalized layout, including unorm8x2, so the requested exhaustive coverage remains incomplete. No test execution is claimed.

outcomes.description: a change in shader-affecting state must select the correct variant, while ordinary uniform edits must not cause needless recompilation.
outcomes.reason: Feature keys and warmup cover selected clipping and output variants, with source regression cases for uniform-only reuse and shadow warmup. The renderer explicitly rejects nonstandard depth modes, leaving the referenced broader clipping/depth/output integration incomplete.

outcomes.description: Pixel-check culling, custom blend, stencil, color masks, polygon offset, depth comparison and instance data on each backend.
outcomes.reason: The browser harness contains pixel assertions for the requested state categories on both backend loops, but skips an unavailable backend and therefore does not require checks to execute on each backend. This audit did not run browser acceptance.

outcomes.description: Define full named/custom blend, depth and alpha semantics consumed by both devices.
outcomes.reason: The shared contract defines and validates named/custom color and alpha blend components and depth comparisons. Both device state paths consume those semantics; this definition does not claim that every hardware-specific combination renders.

outcomes.description: Map full draw state to native pipeline/dynamic state and a deterministic cache key including attachment/layout requirements.
outcomes.reason: Fixed and dynamic state, attachments and layouts feed a deterministic native pipeline key used by device submission. Non-unit instance divisors, packed three-component integer layouts and unnormalized integer-to-float inputs remain explicitly unsupported, so full requested layout breadth is incomplete.

outcomes.description: Verify known color vectors, HDR values above one and below zero, output readback, layered/mip update isolation, changing media frames, compressed-block validation and final cleanup on supported backends.
outcomes.reason: Source tests include extended numerical color vectors and browser cases for output readback, texture isolation, media, compressed-block rejection and cleanup. Extended-range HDR GPU readback across the supported backends was not established in the inspected harnesses. No acceptance was run.

outcomes.description: clean source disposal
outcomes.reason: Texture disposal releases polling, borrowed media and CPU content references after notifying device listeners, without controlling the source owner; source tests cover media retirement and upload-time disposal. This is source coverage, not a current-candidate or acceptance claim.

outcomes.description: negotiated wide-gamut output
outcomes.reason: Both devices have wide-gamut negotiation and native WebGPU supports a verified opaque canvas output and bounded HDR tone route. Offscreen wide-gamut output, direct scene output, preserved alpha and additional postprocess combinations are explicitly unavailable.

outcomes.description: partial uploads
outcomes.reason: Both devices expose offset byte-range buffer writes. The uniform-block API still uploads its entire backing array on every upload, leaving partial updates in the broader shader-data path incomplete.

outcomes.description: mip generation/update
outcomes.reason: Explicit mip updates, WebGL generation, WebGPU source-image mip generation and render-target generation exist. The WebGPU raw-data allocation path uses the supplied mip count and uploads supplied subresources without a corresponding automatic mip-generation path.

outcomes.description: retained dynamic media/layer/mip updates
outcomes.reason: Retained video polling, layer updates and explicit mip revisions exist for supported cases. Live dynamic textures are limited to flat uncompressed 2D, and updating a compressed texture through a decoded WebGPU fallback is explicitly rejected.
